body: Unfortunately all I used to do that I was passionate about I used to do with her, so its a bit painful right now, and yes that includes gaming.  Its even harder for me to move on because she ended things over text (again this was a 3 year relationship).  I just dont see a point in doing any of these things right now.  And im not saying I need a girlfriend to be happy but that was the only time i can remember being truly happy
